Generated Narrative: CodeSystem TrustDemoVerificationResult

This case-sensitive code system http://smart.who.int/trust-demo/CodeSystem/TrustDemoVerificationResult defines the following codes:

CodeDisplayDefinition
verified VerifiedEvery step of verification passed (STT-VER-001).
failed FailedVerification stopped at a step, for a reason from the closed set of STT-VER-008.
unverified Read, not verifiedThe payload was read by read-unverified, with no trust lookup or signature check (STT-VER-011).

name: TrustDemoVerificationResult
title: Result of reading a DVC
description: What the HCERT library returns for one scanned DVC: a verified result, a failed result naming the step and reason (STT-VER-008), or the distinct result of the unverified triage read (STT-VER-011).

concept.definition: Verification stopped at a step, for a reason from the closed set of STT-VER-008.
The payload was read by read-unverified, with no trust lookup or signature check (STT-VER-011).
